open_points.subject: grant_producer_project duplicate-active-grant failure
open_points.text: M15 says the operation "refuses an active duplicate itself, State 4", but flow:administer_service_principals states only that grant_producer_project "appends producer_grant.create" and its Errors section gives no outcome for an already-active grant of the same principal/project pair.
open_points.question: What declared failure and HTTP outcome does grant_producer_project produce when that principal already has an active grant for the project?
options: 403 authorization rejection, matching duplicate active viewer grants and staff assignments
409 conflict, treating the duplicate as a business conflict
open_points.default_guess: 403 authorization rejection before any write or audit

witness.initial: An active granted_projects service principal already has an active ProducerProjectGrant for project P.
events: An authenticated administrator calls the producer-project grant route for the same principal and project P again.
service_identity detects the active duplicate before insertion, as M15 requires.
outcomes: The route returns 403, following the duplicate-active viewer-grant and staff-assignment flows.
The route returns 409, following the general conflict mapping for a rejected duplicate business identity.
witness.observer: The administrator calling the HTTP route sees a different status and client-visible failure classification.
